title: Three Cupboards
subtitle: 健康生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康生活（生活与学习·健康与生活方式）
meta: 主题语境：健康生活（生活与学习·健康与生活方式）　|　核心词汇：alcohol　|　正文 380 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 alcohol 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 my uncle put ① alcohol in a cupboard with the tea and said that was the difference between a drink and a habit, and my grandmother said the difference was nine years and he would find that out. There was ② alcohol in the house before that, meaning the bottle for the coughs, and she said a bottle with a reason on it is the only kind anybody believes; alcohol, she said, is the only thing in a kitchen that is kept behind something.

He ③ gave up alcohol in 1971 for nine months and then did not, and my mother said giving something up twice is the same as never. The doctor wrote the words ④ alcohol abuse in 1974, and my uncle said a word with two syllables is a way of not saying the other one, and my grandmother said he was right and that it did not help; alcohol, the doctor said, is the only medicine you are told to stop.

The ⑤ alcohol itself, meaning the drinking and not the bottle, took eleven years out of a life and a job and one marriage, and he never once used the word. My father said there was ⑥ no alcohol content in the tonic she was given in 1979, and she said a thing that does what it is supposed to without any is the only kind worth paying for; alcohol, my father said, is never the thing people are drinking.

In 1981 he was ⑦ under the influence of alcohol at four in the afternoon, which is the phrase the police used and which my mother wrote down. Every ⑧ alcohol bottle in the house was in a different cupboard by then, and my grandmother said a man who needs three cupboards has admitted everything except the word; alcohol, she said, is the only guest who is asked to leave and stays.

The  alcohol I think about is not the bottle or the tonic or the three cupboards, but the nine months in 1971, which were the only time anybody in that house was happy.  Alcohol, my father said in 1996, is the only thing a family can argue about for thirty-one years without once saying its name, and ours managed forty; the alcohol was in the cupboard with the tea.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 含酒精的饮料；酒
C. n. 饮酒（行为）；喝酒
D. （作定语）含酒精的；酒精的
E. 固定搭配：alcohol abuse / misuse 酗酒；酒精滥用
F. 固定搭配：alcohol content / level 酒精含量
G. 固定搭配：give up alcohol 戒酒
H. 固定搭配：under the influence of alcohol 酒后；受酒精影响

items.q: put alcohol in a cupboard with the tea
There was alcohol in the house
The alcohol itself, meaning the drinking
no alcohol content in the tonic
under the influence of alcohol at four
Every alcohol bottle in the house

answers.why: alcohol 意为“含酒精的饮料、酒”，1969 年叔叔把酒放进放茶叶的柜子，说这就是“喝一杯”和“成习惯”的区别。
alcohol 意为“酒精”，此前屋里也有酒精，就是那瓶治咳嗽的药水。
give up alcohol 意为“戒酒”，1971 年他戒了九个月，后来又没戒成。
alcohol abuse 意为“酗酒、酒精滥用”，1974 年医生写下了这个词。
alcohol 意为“饮酒（行为）”，真正夺走十一年人生、一份工作和一次婚姻的是饮酒本身，而不是那只瓶子。
alcohol content 意为“酒精含量”，1979 年医生给她开的补剂里不含任何酒精。
under the influence of alcohol 意为“酒后、受酒精影响”，1981 年下午四点他处于酒后状态。
alcohol 作定语，意为“含酒精的”，那时屋里每一个酒瓶都分别藏在不同的柜子里。
